name: DOGE Late-Confirmed Reversal
description: Right after a 15-minute DOGE window opens, if the previous window moved a lot (>1.5 usual standard deviations) and its last 5 minutes also ran hard the same way, buy the side betting on a reversal. Bursts into the 15-minute boundary tend to give some back; the Kalshi DOGE price at the open treats the window as a coin flip.
hypothesis: Same mechanism as eth-midrev/sol-midrev, rule UNCHANGED (L=300 s, |z15|>1.5, |z5|>1.5 same sign, first 1.5 min, mid 30-70c), on KXDOGE15M whose history was never used to design it. Losers: opening takers/quoters pricing the window as a coin flip. Wrong if: full walk-forward not promising (CI>0, >=60% months positive, positive at 2x latency), or lockbox loses.
next: Lockbox failed (-4.7c). Rejected; do not rerun.
